mapper.select: SELECT ss.seat_id AS seat_id, s.row_num AS `row`, s.col_num AS col, s.seat_type AS type, ss.status AS status FROM hx_session_seats ss INNER JOIN hx_seats s ON ss.seat_id = s.id WHERE ss.session_id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY ss.seat_id, s.row_num, s.col_num, s.seat_type, ss.status ORDER BY s.row_num, s.col_num
